steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I have seen your report.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Your achievements with Reunion are, to say the least, not worthy of commendation.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: However, that being said, you have indeed procured some unexpectedly useful information.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Thank——

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: No, there is no need for thanks. At least, not this time.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You are all impressive warriors, and until your deaths, you are entitled to the rewards you've earned by virtue of the blood, sweat, and tears you have shed.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: His Majesty the Regent knows well the acts and deeds of all Sarkaz, even those as insignificant as yourself.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The Infected are not the only thing in this temple gradually depreciating. Do you understand?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I do.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: If I am correct in my predictions, Rhodes Island has already welcomed the return of a certain unpalatable individual.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: And you... you should have made contact.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: (The Regent is even faster than W? All the way from Londinium?!)

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Mercenaries know loyalty only to their own interests. But that nonetheless makes a fine starting point.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: When the dust settles, and you stand once again before the throne of His Majesty——

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: That is when you will receive your reward.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And what about the other warriors?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: The young Infected has her own plans. Were you unaware?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: But His Majesty will not participate in such nonsense. We have mutually decided that Victoria will stand by and watch Reunion's next move.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: We lack 'effective measures' to retake control of that unit from W.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Furthermore, it is important that we, in the name of our supporters, continue to whip up the Infected in all corners of the world.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We're still going to use Reunion? I was sure His Majesty would have...

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Given up? Oh my no, young mercenary.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Things are yet far from chaotic enough. Even if Reunion has strayed from its leadership, it remains a source of chaos——

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: What's more, should your words just now be taken as a question of His Majesty's intentions?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: No, absolutely not.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Very well. Raise your head...

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Oh, yes.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: For the time being, you need not return to Kazdel. The journey back is too long, and matters have been progressing rapidly there.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: You are to stay here, for now. Enjoy this small respite however you can.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Thank you very much.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Now then, His Majesty awaits me. You are dismissed.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Remember, see to your own business first, Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: Hoederer, yes?

steps.name: Confessarius
steps.text: I look forward to seeing what else you uncover.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Looks like it's house arrest for both of us?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It's not like I never thought about it. And hey, it's better than I was expecting...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But we were a little too naive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Which part was naive? The part where you thought you'd die, or the part where you thought the Regent didn't know?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Both. He's been pulling the strings from the start.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Not that I'm surprised... he's Theresis. We've all heard the stories about him and Theresa, the invincible forces of nature...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But I guess in the course of the war, I forgot those stories... weren't just stories.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: So how do we warn W? What's going on with Reunion?

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: We wasted so much time on the road. She might've already split with Talulah.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The other possibility is the show ends in Lungmen.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Wouldn't that be a bit too quick?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It fits with the way W works. If Talulah's gonna destroy the Infected, W'll destroy Talulah first.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sarkaz style. With extreme prejudice.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's pretty upset over the death of a certain merc, after all.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: She knows the score.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She's out of room to hesitate any longer. Now she just needs to get into the right headspace to make a move.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: And that means we're left waiting.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've got ways to fool the Regent's eyes. It'd be a crazy risky play, but...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've still got my own squad I can keep on 'standby.'

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Victoria's all over the place right now. They probably wouldn't catch the code.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah, and it would have to pass by some real tricky spots controlled by the Regent... and on to Kazdel.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Kazdel?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The battlefield ruins there haven't been touched in a long time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But we eked out a living there for a good long time.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: There was a communications station in an old bunker buried under those ruins. The tower made it look like it was destroyed, but everything down there still works.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Hold on, that was a long time ago...

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: How long have you been preparing this?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: All done way back at the very beginning. Cost me a pretty penny too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Heh heh.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Oh man... if they saw the look on your face right now, boy would they be surprised.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: For a while now, every time you came back from a battle, you were always deep in thought, like a kid who did something bad.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: I figured you'd just lost your will to fight.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Nah, it was the opposite, actually. I finally realized what it was I had to do.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: How?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Because I had no choice. It's kind of liberating, in a way?

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: W must've said something to you before you left Chernobog.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Does that sound like her? Laying all the cards on the table?

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: No. She'd be a lot less of a pain if she did though.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're right that she came looking for me before I left the core city. She knew what we were going to do.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: She...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Can you put a price on the life of a merc?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sure. Always have. Why even ask? You knew the answer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But who set the price?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The war itself.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sure... you got your battlefield honors, your victories, the glory you pull out of a hand-to-hand fight, all the things that raise your profile, that let everybody know what a useful tool you are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So boring.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But that's all in the past. At least for us it is.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...What do you mean?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Every Sarkaz merc should have a nice, clean price tag.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But we don't need anybody to slap it on. No oversight. They write their own price in the blood of the enemies of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You... are you saying we should get everyone to leave Kazdel...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You look surprised. But like, they could choose for themselves.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Does this sound weird?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Not weird, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Just give it some thought... think about what you could be doing in Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're talking about doing that right in front of Theresis, in broad daylight.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You make it sound so bad. As if you don't have your own plans.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Chill... you were my boss, Hoederer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You'd better do it, or we'll have trouble.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: That's a pretty good joke. The old hands at the Scar Market would laugh themselves into a coma.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: It certainly wouldn't make the committee happy. They'd be out a lotta money, and a lotta wasted brainpower.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Not to mention all the people they killed.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sure enough... and the old hands there too... some of them are almost friends of ours...

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: So what are you gonna do now? It's up to you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Well... I can't leave Londinium. Hell, I can't even leave this mansion.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I think it's up to you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: You can do a lot as a 'Messenger.'

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'Keep following Talulah's orders. Hoederer isn't coming back yet.' Should be good?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: As long as that comms station still works, we'll hear back. And they'll get word to W.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: I know how to do this.

steps.name: Sarkaz Messenger
steps.text: Don't give me orders.

steps.name: W
steps.text: *Sigh*... What a pain in the ass...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Just when I decide to go after the dragon lady... What a time you picked.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Get out here.
The ruins of Chernobog weren't like those of Kazdel.
There were still traces of life out on the streets, ravaged as they were. They gave you some idea of what had been.
Unlike the total annihilation back there.
Like, for example...
Those two kids. Kids painstakingly raising their weapons.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Devil! What are you doing here?!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: N-no, don't provoke her...

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: S-sorry... we were just leaving...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hey—

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's an army sword you're holding, isn't it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yes, it is. Sarkaz steel... You can't even lift it. Why are you hauling that thing around?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You gonna fight back? You gonna kill me?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Eeep——

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: G-get back——agh!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev... your leg!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, you're hurt.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're gonna get infected. This city got hit with a Catastrophe. It's not safe here.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: I won't turn into a thing like you!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Aww. What a tough kid.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let me ask you——

steps.name: W
steps.text: ——Do you know what it means to take up the blade of a fallen Sarkaz?
